critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1025 lines single-file. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, professionals, bookings, payments, coupons, boost, subscription, admin) — maintenance risk grows fast.

Coupon uniqueness is per-professional (unique on {professional_id, code}). No DB unique index enforcing this — two concurrent creates could bypass the app-level find_one check. Add a compound unique index on db.coupons(professional_id, code).

GET /api/coupons/validate compares valid_until (ISO string) via lexicographic '<' against datetime.now().isoformat(). Works only if valid_until is stored as UTC ISO with same offset format ('+00:00'). Client sending 'YYYY-MM-DD' or naive ISO could produce wrong result. Recommend parsing to datetime for comparison.
list_professionals runs an N+1: for every pro it queries services + reviews aggregate. With growth this will be slow. Batch via $lookup or bulk fetch.

distance_km sort places pros without coords at 99999 — they appear last even if boosted+featured (they still get priority by first two keys, so ok). But rating tiebreaker uses -avg_rating; None avg treated as 0 (correct).
BOOST/SUB stripe error 500 message leaks 'Stripe: ...' — fine for internal but consider generic message for prod.
featured_until stored as ISO string; comparison p['featured_until'] > now (ISO strings) — same caveat as coupon expiry.
SUB_PLANS/BOOST_PLANS hardcoded; consider moving to config/env for pricing agility.
notify_whatsapp callers previously flagged; no change needed for iter3.
